items.title: Sweet Williams Interview
items.q: And Lawrence O'Brien, the Irishman. Where? Lawrence O'Brien's joint.

ctx.x: And where did you play with Hurt Moran?
On Clock Street in the Honky Tonks. The Firehouse. The joint they call the Firehouse. And Lawrence O'Brien, the Irishman. Where? Lawrence O'Brien's joint.
